# Camp Resource: Red Rocket Dumpster

Thankfully someone already sorted this junk into Plastics for you.

Red Rocket Dumpster generates Junk.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Red Rocket Dumpster__

**Produces**

Toy Alien

Cafeteria Tray

Cat Bowl

Dog Bowl

Hairbrush

Plastic Knife

Plastic Knife - Black

Plastic Knife - Orange

Plastic Pumpkin

One Ball (Pool Ball)

Three Ball (Pool Ball)

Up to Fifteen Ball (Pool Ball)

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

2 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Red Rocket Dumpster__ - 500 Atoms

Atom Shop - __The Red Rocket Dumpster Bundle__ - 1500 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

6 Flamingo Units
